This is an update of Zero's translation, with the missing pages (p15-16 and p19-20) translated by me. I tried my best to match the original typesetting and text style.

The original translation can be found here: https://e-hentai.org/g/1256592/008a9c34cb

NOTE: it's my first time uploading anything to the site. I don't speak JP, so I had to rely on dictionaries, machine translation and context. So constructive criticism is welcome.
